# Native saved-project fragments

`studio-02.09.02.62-save.json` contains the exact root/component mesh XML and
only the exporter-selected settings from an actual Bambu Studio 02.09.02.62
Save Project operation on the shipped OpenPrintLab staircase.

The source/saved archive hashes identify the actual local round-trip. This is
**not a complete project or usable printer preset**. Machine/filament G-code,
full vendor profiles, accounts, personal filesystem paths and screenshots are
not included. Geometry is the original CC BY 4.0 OpenPrintLab model; test
fixture packaging is MIT. Settings are a small factual selection, not a
redistributed preset bundle. See the feature evidence for scope and remaining
native layer-review limitations.
